item.title: Jesse Jackson dies at 84
item.description: Jesse Jackson Sr., a longtime civil rights activist who twice vied for the Democratic presidential nomination in the 1980s, died February 17 at age 84. A protégé of Martin Luther King Jr., Jackson was the founder of the Rainbow PUSH Coalition, a social justice organization, but he intertwined his advocacy with politics and diplomacy, serving as a special envoy to Africa for the Clinton administration and as a shadow senator representing Washington, DC, in the 1990s.

item.title: Giving silence a seat at the virtual table
item.description: “Silence spoken here.” I first read this phrase in reference to the Abbey of Gethsemani, the Trappist monastery in Kentucky. Silence has been spoken there for more than 175 years. It has been spoken in the Christian tradition for millennia more.
